one_liner: Gladly has a broad REST API with per-user API tokens (HTTP Basic) and an OpenAPI spec, but access requires a Gladly customer instance obtained via demo/sales; no self-serve signup or trial is documented.
auth_notes: API token generated in Gladly settings by a user with the API User permission; used as the password with the agent's email as the Basic username. Tokens are tied to a user and environment (sandbox vs production). Lookup API uses signed requests, but that is for Gladly calling the developer's service.
access_notes: Tokens are created inside a customer's Gladly instance by an administrator-granted API User permission. No free tier or self-serve trial is shown in the fetched pages; third-party connector docs say a demo and sales contact are needed. Not directly confirmed from vendor pages, so confidence is lowered.
blocker_notes: A builder needs a Gladly instance (demo/sales conversation) to get a sandbox or API token. No self-serve path is documented.
